The <b>Seeker's Soul</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i> [[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Seeker's Soul can be given to the [[Caretaker]] in [[Songclave]] along with the [[Maiden's Soul]], [[Hermit's Soul]], and [[Snare Setter]] to complete the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wish.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sherma 07.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Caretaker 01.png!Caretaker in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Seeker's Soul can be found at [[Bilewater#Sub-area: Bilehaven|Bilehaven]] in [[Bilewater]] after defeating [[Groal the Great]]. It is below a corpse of a [[Snail Shamans|Snail Shaman]] which shrivels up after the Seeker's Soul is acquired.
